positions.title: Online Learning Support Specialist
positions.description:
Process incoming phone, chat messages and emails for technical support with online courses and general college questions. 
Utilize service tracking software for recording data of assistance requests from students, faculty, staff and guest with related history.
Participate in professional development seminars to improve online courses and related criteria.
Process office staff orientations and on-the-job training for reception and administrative assistance workers; developed and maintain office procedures manual. 
Coordinate and assist with Federal Work Study and general employment applications, interviews, and hiring documentation and processes.
